summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of KopiLokal landing page. All 8 user stories verified successfully. Frontend-only testing performed as per requirements.
passed_tests: User Story 1: Hero CTA 'Lihat Menu' scrolls directly to #menu catalog section
User Story 2: Filter 'Kopi' shows exactly 6 coffee drinks (Kopi Signature + Espresso Based categories)
User Story 3: Filter 'Non-Kopi' shows exactly 4 items (Non-Kopi + Refreshment categories)
User Story 4: Filter 'Makanan Ringan' shows exactly 3 snack products (Pastry & Snack category)
User Story 5: Filter 'Semua' restores all 13 real menu cards
User Story 6: Per-product WhatsApp button has wa.me/6281228483649 with exact encoded message 'Halo KopiLokal, saya ingin memesan [Nama Produk].'
User Story 7: Address (Jl. Yudistira No5), hours (08.00-23.00), and Instagram (@fotokopi.idn) are visible and correct
User Story 8: Mobile hamburger opens usable navigation and mobile anchor links work
Desktop and mobile responsive layout verified - no horizontal overflow
All navbar links (Menu, Tentang Kami, Lokasi, Kontak) work correctly
External WhatsApp, Instagram, and Google Maps links use new tab with noopener/noreferrer security
Keyboard accessibility verified with proper focus states
aria-pressed state on filter buttons works correctly
All 13 product names, descriptions, and prices are correctly displayed
Product cards have proper illustration/image semantics with visual icons
Warm brown/cream/ochre color palette implemented correctly
No console errors or red screen errors detected
Mobile hamburger menu navigation tested and working
Filter counts display correctly (Semua: 13, Kopi: 6, Non-Kopi: 4, Makanan Ringan: 3)
